## Problem

What problem does this solve, or what's missing today? (e.g. "There's no
way to adjust the crop-rect padding before export.")

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or change you'd like to see.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Scope

Which part of the project does this touch?

- [ ] `turnip-ios` (this repo)
- [ ] `turnip-farm` (backend, separate repo)
- [ ] `turnip-ml` (ML pipeline, separate repo)
- [ ] Not sure

## Additional context

Mockups, references to similar features elsewhere, or links to relevant
sections of [`docs/DESIGN.md`](../../docs/DESIGN.md), if applicable.
